seed_data_creation: Created TEST_Profile_Display_Demo influencer with full platform-specific audience demographics via API for profile page testing. Instagram: 18-24 (45%), 25-34 (35%), Female (75%), Mumbai (35%). YouTube: 25-34 (40%), 35-44 (35%), Male (60%), International (45%).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Platform-specific audience demographics fully implemented and tested. Key data structure: audience_demographics: {instagram: {age_split, gender_split, city_split}, youtube: {age_split, gender_split, city_split}}. Each split is array of objects like [{group: '18-24', percentage: 45}]. Frontend form has separate sections with pink gradient for Instagram, red gradient for YouTube. Profile page displays demographics with color-coded progress bars per platform. Legacy format (direct age_split/gender_split/city_split without platform keys) is also supported for backward compatibility.
